The '''Airam Clans''' were the unified clans of the [[Airam (group)|Airam]]. Known clan leaders were [[Tamaron]] and [[Ilay]].<ref name="XvT">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter: Balance of Power]]''</ref> The Airam Clans joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and were reorganized as the [[Airam Sector Force]]. The Clans were known to be able to support respectable fleets and armies from its own resources.<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>
